question: A sum of ₹x amounts to ₹83,853 in 2(1)/(2) years at 12% p.a., interest compounded 10-monthly. What is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **10-monthly** compounding, rate per period = 12% × (10/12) = **10%**.

Total periods for 2.5 years (30 months) = 30 ÷ 10 = **3 periods**.

Using **Ratio Method**: 10% = 1/10 ⇒ Amount/Principal = (11/10)³ = 1331/1000.

1331 units = ₹83,853 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹83,853 ÷ 1331 = ₹63.

Principal (x) = 1000 units = 1000 × 63 = ₹63,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹63,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Amount (A)** = ₹83,853 | **Annual Rate (R)** = 12% | **Time (T)** = 2.5 years = 30 months.

**Compounding** = 10-monthly.

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f3e84dc710be53c97754d136f4f911dc607a3b102f95ae233c8846181cd5574.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Effective rate (r) = 12% × (10/12) = 10% per period

⇒ Number of periods (n) = 30 ÷ 10 = 3

⇒ 83,853 = x(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 83,853 = x(1.1)³

⇒ 83,853 = x × 1.331

⇒ x = 83,853 ÷ 1.331

⇒ x = 83,853,000 ÷ 1331

⇒ x = 63,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹63,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Compounding

When interest is compounded k-monthly, the rate used is (R ÷ 12) × k and the number of periods is (Total months ÷ k).

Compound Interest Formula

Amount A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where P is principal, r is rate per period, and n is the number of periods.

Successive Percentage Method

For 3 periods of 10% each, the effective percentage increase is 10 + 10 + (10×10)/100 = 21%, then 21 + 10 + (21×10)/100 = 33.1%.
